hero.badge: SynTract Labs — Intelligent Software & Autonomous Systems
hero.body: SynTract Labs develops production software, published mobile applications, AI agents, and autonomous operating systems. At the center is SynTract CorTex™, our governed AI orchestration platform designed to move organizations from intent to execution.

outputs_section.heading: Intelligent products. Autonomous systems. Real-world execution.
outputs_section.body: SynTract Labs develops mobile applications, custom software, AI agents, and autonomous operating systems. At the center is SynTract CorTex™, our governed AI orchestration platform designed to move organizations from intent to execution.

engine_section.heading: From intent to execution.
engine_section.body: CorTex turns operational objectives into governed execution by interpreting goals, applying organizational rules, prioritizing work, coordinating specialized agents, and keeping human operators in control.

bcu_section.heading: Build software faster without sacrificing ownership.
bcu_section.body: The SynTract Build Engine accelerates the creation of mobile apps, web applications, AI agents, backend services, and enterprise software. Build Compute Units provide a transparent measure of the computational work required to create each product.
bcu_section.meter_note: BCU consumption scales with complexity, file count, integrations, and AI reasoning depth. Top-up packs are available when additional build capacity is needed.

audience_section.heading: From mobile products to autonomous operations.
audience_section.body: SynTract Labs supports founders, growing businesses, and enterprise teams with production software, AI systems, custom development, and governed autonomous execution.

ownership_section.heading: From concept to production.
ownership_section.body: SynTract Labs designs, develops, and delivers mobile applications and custom software from concept through release. Our work spans consumer apps, AI-powered products, custom platforms, enterprise tools, AI agents, and autonomous operating systems.

cta_section.heading: Have something ambitious in mind?
cta_section.body: Whether you're building a mobile product, introducing AI into an existing business, or moving toward autonomous operations, SynTract Labs can take it from concept to execution.
